messages:
maria: Quick design review 12 new 'Create API key' modal feels overwhelming. Too many toggles, big permission table, and the large warning copy is pushing the CTA down. (attached screenshot)
joel: Agree. Primary CTA gets lost. Suggest making the 'Create' button sticky at the bottom and moving advanced options under a 'Show advanced' accordion.
tess: Accessibility note: when the secret is revealed it's not announced to screen readers. We should add an aria-live region (e.g., aria-live="polite") or move focus to the secret container when revealed. Clipboard button needs aria-label="Copy API key" not just "Copy".
ethan: Frontend detail: current flow calls `clipboard.copy(apiKey)` on click but we don't show a toast. Add an ephemeral toast: 'Key copied 12 this is the only time you'll see it'. Also add a keyboard shortcut and visible focus state for the copy action.
sara: Copy tweak: prefer 'Save this key securely 12 it won’t be viewable again.' It's shorter and less scary than 'only time'.
designbot: :eyes: Proposal: compress the permission matrix into a per-key preset dropdown for common roles and an 'Advanced scopes' expandable table for power users. That reduces vertical clutter for most users.
maria: Good idea. Also thinking about rotation/revoke UX 12 add a 'soft revoke' (disable for 24h) option so product teams can roll back accidental revokes. We need a clear mental model in the copy so users understand differences between soft and permanent revoke.
joel: Implementation idea: show inline toast on revoke with 'Undo (30s)' and a small 'Revoke permanently' link. For soft-revoke, surface a timer on the key card and an action to cancel.
aria-bot: Accessibility check: after creation, move focus to the created key card and announce via screen reader: 'API key created. Use the copy button to copy the secret.' Ensure the created key card is reachable by keyboard and has meaningful aria-labels.
tess: Empty-state suggestion for the credentials page: headline 'No API keys yet' + CTA 'Create API key' + one-line guidance: 'Create scoped keys for services; rotate regularly. Learn more.' Link to docs.
ethan: I'll mock two compact variants (sticky CTA vs accordion) by EOD and include an a11y checklist. Tagging @maria for prioritization.
maria: Thanks 12 can we cover this in the 30m design crits? :thumbsup:
